note: This file is a pure MMEngine/MMPose configuration file containing only variable assignments and dict literals. It has no functions, classes, or callable code. It is used to configure training of the Sapiens 1B pose estimation model on the COCO WholeBody dataset.
summary: Configuration for training sapiens_1b (1536 embed_dim, 40 layers) on COCO WholeBody at 1024x768 resolution for 210 epochs with AdamW optimizer, layer decay, UDPHeatmap codec, and VisionTransformer backbone.
